goal: Compare existing company metrics through the approved modern table, stable local sorting and accessible field help without changing scope, accounting or surrounding UI.
non_goals: No real Supabase use or business writes
No row drilldown, global restyling or preview code promotion
No changes to prior workflow records or Git publication
expected_evidence: Focused red/green actual-source tests and classic baselines
Full offline suite, bundle, syntax and diff checks
Actual-source isolated browser checks for A1-A7 including mobile and form/monthly compatibility
Independent source review findings with direct citations and honest native acceptance status
unsafe_assumptions: Prototype checks do not establish production completion
Public logo identity may not exactly match stored display-name grouping
Unknown ROI and missing historical event dates cannot be fabricated
Sorting must not reset other components or persist settings
stop_condition: Stop unless native entry is ok:true with an authorized tracked tasks baseline; stop on scope/review/test failures or missing decisions. Never bypass by committing, editing real records or marking assertions complete.
